distractorPolicy.selection: shuffle eligible candidates within each priority tier; take same-city candidates first, then fill remaining slots from the same country
distractorPolicy.fallback: If fewer than three eligible same-city or same-country distractors exist, do not serve the question; flag the record for dataset expansion.

datasetNotes: Thirty stadium records across England, Spain, Italy, Germany, Brazil and Mexico.
Five records per country ensure a same-country candidate pool for every question.
Same-city distractors are preferred; same-country distractors fill any remaining slots.
Illustration paths are planned only; no image files are included in this commit.
All records are disabled and require editorial/source review before production.
